desc:
🚢 Welcome to Build A Hovercraft!

💰 Buy blocks from the shop!
🔨 Design and customize your very own hovercraft!
🌲 Launch your hovercraft to begin the adventure and dodge obstacles along the way!
📦 Unlock new blocks and upgrade your hovercraft!

🌊 How far can your hovercraft travel?

💤 Your hovercraft drives offline!
